evidence.title: Animation Video Peddled As NASA Releasing Footage Of ...
evidence.snippet_en: BOOM Fact Check rated as False the claim that a video shows a glimpse of Chandrayaan 3 captured by NASA, stating it is an animation.

evidence.title: Fact-Check: Old Stock Video Shared as Visuals of Moon Captured ...
evidence.snippet_en: The Quint rated as False the claim that a video is recent and shows visuals of the moon captured by Chandrayaan-3, stating it is an old stock video.

evidence.title: Fact-Check | No, This Is Not NASA's Footage of Chandrayaan-3 ...
evidence.snippet_en: The Quint rated as False the claim that a video is actual footage of Chandrayaan-3 landing by NASA, stating it is an old video.

evidence.title: Animated Clip Of Blue Moon Lander Viral As Chandrayaan-3 ...
evidence.snippet_en: BOOM Fact Check rated as False the claim that a video shows Chandrayaan-3's Vikram lander landing on the Moon's south pole, stating it is an animated clip.

evidence.title: Unrelated visuals shared as Chandrayaan-3's landing footage
evidence.snippet_en: FACTLY rated as FALSE the claim that visuals show the Vikram lander making a soft landing on the moon captured by NASA, stating they are unrelated animated Apollo 11 landing visuals.

evidence.title: 'NASA footage', 'Ashoka Stambh on lunar surface': Fake visuals ...
evidence.snippet_en: Alt News rated as False the claim that NASA released footage of Chandrayaan landing on the moon and that the Ashoka Stambh will be imprinted on the lunar surface, stating these are fake visuals.

evidence.title: Simulation of India's lunar mission falsely shared as proof of 'Moon ...
evidence.snippet_en: AFP Fact Check rated as False the claim that an animation of India's lunar rocket proves its Moon landing was faked, stating it is a simulation.

evidence.title: Fake video of Earth was not captured by India's spacecraft
evidence.snippet_en: AFP Fact Check rated as False the claim that India's lunar spacecraft Chandrayaan 3 sent footage of Earth, stating it is a fake video.

evidence.title: Fact Check: This captivating photo of Earth from the Moon was not ...
evidence.snippet_en: India Today rated as False the claim that a photo of the Earth was shot from the Moon’s surface by Chandrayaan-3, stating it was AI-generated.

evidence.title: Claims Of China Being The First Country To Land On The South ...
evidence.snippet_en: BOOM Fact Check rated as False the claim that China was the first country to land on the moon's South Pole a few years ago.

evidence.title: Unrelated Visuals Passed Off as Live Visuals of Moon Captured by ...
evidence.snippet_en: The Quint rated as False the claim that a video is recent and shows live visuals of the moon captured by ISRO's Chandrayaan-3, stating they are unrelated visuals.

evidence.title: Stock Video Misleadingly Shared As First Lunar Visuals From ...
evidence.snippet_en: BOOM Fact Check rated as False the claim that a visual is of the moon's surface from Chandrayaan-3, stating it is stock footage.

evidence.title: Picture Of National Emblem, ISRO Logo Imprint On Moon's Surface ...
evidence.snippet_en: BOOM Fact Check rated as False the claim that a photo shows an imprint of ISRO's logo and national emblem on the moon's surface.

outputs.notes_en: The fact checks primarily address various fake videos and images related to the Chandrayaan-3 mission, such as animated footage being passed off as real, or AI-generated images. There is one fact check that directly contradicts the claim that China was the first to land on the moon's south pole, which supports the claim that India was the first. There are no fact checks directly addressing the claim about people celebrating the landing.
